body.name: CompatOffsetZero
body.space: a linear subspace of \(\mathbb R^{|\mathcal J_0^{\mathrm{act}}|}\)
body.def: Let \(A_{\Psi}\) have rows \(\alpha_j^{\prime}\), \(j\in\mathcal J_0^{\mathrm{act}}\). Define \(\mathcal K_0=\{A_{\Psi}z:z\in\mathbb R^{|\mathcal J|},\mathbf1^{\prime}z=0\}\), equivalently the solution set of the exact rational left-nullspace equations of \(A_{\Psi}\) restricted to the simplex tangent space.
body.role: explicit compatibility relations for finite limiting offsets
